evidence.note: Meta's own launch post (a company disclosure, but the contract prefers this for product aims) shows Muse doing tasks like booking travel and making purchases. It does not name restaurants or tickets.
Contemporaneous NYT syndication says Muse links to OpenTable and Ticketmaster and books restaurant reservations and concert tickets.
2015 launch statement shows M aimed to book restaurants and travel and buy items. This is the historical baseline.
2017 reporting shows M ordered movie tickets and handled restaurant queries. This establishes M's past tasks.

reviews.rationale: Both products aimed at the same consumer concierge tasks. M booked restaurants, travel and tickets (e4, e5). In its launch period, Muse books travel, restaurant reservations via OpenTable and concert tickets via Ticketmaster (e2, e3). Theatre tickets specifically are not shown, but that was one example under 'and so on'. Nothing shows Muse excluding these tasks.
